Question: What is the benefit of using try-with-resources in this code block?
Code: try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("file.txt"))) {\n    System.out.println(reader.readLine());\n}
Explanation: It ensures that the BufferedReader (and underlying FileReader) is automatically closed when the try block exits, even if an exception occurs, avoiding resource leaks.
